summary: First test run of Sanctuary Screens POC. Comprehensive backend pytest suite (39 tests) + Playwright critical UI flows (PIN gate, Register admin publish → live display, Bible lookup/publish/next/prev/chip/clear, WebSocket reconnect after backend restart, responsive). All 39 backend tests pass. Critical UI flows pass including live WebSocket sync and state resync after `supervisorctl restart backend`.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 48: lock_until string compared against ISO string — works lexically but comparing ISO strings only works if TZ is consistent (both include +00:00). Minor fragility; recommend storing/comparing datetimes.

server.py seed_translations is started as a background task on startup — /api/health reports translations=1 only after seeding completes; health endpoint will briefly return translations=0 on cold start. Low priority.

bible_routes.lookup_passage: in-memory book cache `_books_cache` is never invalidated on translation import/delete beyond pop(code,None) — fine; just confirm multi-worker safety (one FastAPI process so OK).
No DELETE endpoint for register_services — testing requires direct Mongo access to clean up. Consider adding admin DELETE for maintenance.
CORS: allow_credentials=False but allow_origins can be '*' from env default — acceptable for POC but tighten for deployment.
frontend/src/components/live/PinGate.jsx retry UX is good; however on 429 lockout, user sees the lockout message but no visible timer countdown — minor polish.
test_credentials: Admin PIN 1234 (shared register+bible). /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty (not populated).
seed_data_creation: Created TST translation and TEST_ register records / prepared items for tests; all deleted in teardown. KJV left installed. Bible display left cleared to idle. Active register service reset to 2026-10-04 (pre-existing).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_sanctuary.py exercises Auth/Register/BibleLookup/BibleLive/Translations(CSV import w/ TST code)/Prepared/WebSocket. CSV REQUIRED columns are: translation,book,chapter,verse,text (NOT translation_code/book_name). Preview DNS blocks urllib/requests from non-browser user agents for some endpoints — use page.evaluate+fetch for inside-browser API calls when needed. During earlier parallel runs the display briefly showed an unrelated 'Psalm 46:1' publish — appeared external; controlled sequential test showed deterministic correct WS sync. WS reconnect confirmed working after `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`. All backend tests pass in 2 xdist workers.
